props.name: options
props.description: List of options to display in the mobile sheet

props.name: groups
props.description: List of option groups to display in the mobile sheet

props.name: selected
props.description: Currently selected option(s). Single: T | null, Multi: T[]

props.name: size
props.description: Size scale of the trigger field (`"sm"` | `"md"` | `"lg"`). Defaults to `"md"`.

props.name: labelKey
props.description: Field name for display label (default "label")

props.name: valueKey
props.description: Field name for unique value (default "value")

props.name: label
props.description: Label text displayed above the component

props.name: labelWrapperClass
props.description: Label wrapper custom class

props.name: labelClass
props.description: Label element custom class

props.name: labelHint
props.description: Hint element beside label

props.name: description
props.description: Description shown in the top header of the mobile sheet

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Placeholder text shown when no value is selected

props.name: multiple
props.description: Multi-select mode

props.name: maxSelection
props.description: Maximum selections allowed in multi-select mode

props.name: showSelectAll
props.description: Shows a 1-click Select All / Deselect All header in multi-select mode

props.name: confirmText
props.description: Primary CTA button text for multi-select confirmation (default "Apply Selection")

props.name: searchable
props.description: Enables search input bar inside the bottom sheet

props.name: searchPlaceholder
props.description: Search input placeholder inside sheet

props.name: async
props.description: Enables async search mode (server-side search)

props.name: onSearch
props.description: Callback triggered when user types in async search mode

props.name: loading
props.description: Loading state spinner inside search bar or option list

props.name: typeToSearchText
props.description: Text displayed in async mode before typing query

props.name: filterOption
props.description: Custom search filter predicate for client-side filtering

props.name: quickOptions
props.description: Quick-access 1-tap option chips displayed above option list

props.name: quickOptionsTitle
props.description: Section header for quick-access chips (default "Quick Picks")

props.name: allowClear
props.description: Enables clear (X) button on single-select trigger

props.name: allowFreeText
props.description: Enables typing custom freeform text inside the mobile search bar

props.name: allowAdd
props.description: Enables "+ Create" option card when search query doesn't match existing options

props.name: addNewText
props.description: Label prefix for creatable option action (default "Create")

props.name: onAdd
props.type: (value: string) => string | void | T | Promise<string | void | T>
props.raw: (value: string) => string | void | T | Promise<string | void | T>
props.description: Callback when user clicks the creatable option

props.name: leftGroup
props.description: Icon or element displayed inside the trigger on the left

props.name: error
props.description: Shows error state border and message

props.name: showErrorMessage
props.description: Shows error message below field (default true)

props.name: helperText
props.description: Helper guidance message rendered below field

props.name: noOptionsText
props.description: Message shown in the dropdown when options are empty

props.name: renderOption
props.description: Custom option renderer function

props.name: containerClass
props.description: Outer container class

props.name: sheetClass
props.description: Sheet panel custom class
